show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/5kqhaW
show.description: Majdoor No. 1 follows Tanay, a silent construction worker mocked as “Ghajini” due to memory loss from a brutal attack. Exploited and abused, his life changes when fragments of his past resurface, revealing he is Aryan Roy, the rightful heir to a powerful business empire. As Tanay fights injustice, uncovers conspiracies, and confronts the man who stole his identity, he rises from an oppressed laborer to a fearless crusader for truth, dignity, and justice.
